notes: The official careers URL lands on https://www.hdfc.bank.in/careers, which links to the RippleHire board https://hdfcbank.ripplehire.com/candidate/careers. The board is a JS shell; results come from POST https://hdfcbank.ripplehire.com/candidate/candidatejobsearch with one form field careerSiteUrlParams = JSON {page, search, token, source:'CAREERSITE', pagesize} plus lang=en. 'search' is a query string (unfiltered default '*:*'), so keyword/city text works server-side; verified search='Mumbai' returned totalJobCount 137. The response also carries cityCount/departmentsCount/bussinessUnitCount/jobLevelCount aggregation maps, but the request has no facet keys, so location/department must be filtered locally.
evidence: POST /candidate/candidatejobsearch careerSiteUrlParams={"page":0,"search":"Mumbai","token":"...","source":"CAREERSITE","pagesize":10} -> totalJobCount 137, maxJobSize 10, rows with locations='Mumbai'
response keys include startJobIndex, maxJobSize, totalJobCount, jobVoList, cityCount, departmentsCount, bussinessUnitCount, jobLevelCount
